{{Short description|Russian physicist}}
'''Anatoly Alexandrovich Maslov''' ({{Langx|ru|Анатолий Александрович Маслов}}; born 7 August 1946) is a Russian [[physicist]] and a professor at the Aerohydrodynamic Department at the [[Novosibirsk State Technical University]], specialist in the field of [[laminar–turbulent transition]].<ref name="fam">{{Cite web |title=доктор технических наук, профессор Маслов Анатолий Александрович |url=https://famous-scientists.ru/anketa/maslov-anatolij-aleksandrovich-9249 |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=famous-scientists.ru |language=ru}}</ref>

==Biography==
In 1973, Anatoly Maslov defended his Ph.D. thesis "Stability of a compressible boundary layer over a cooled surface"; in 1988, he defended his doctoral dissertation "The onset of turbulence in supersonic boundary layers".<ref name="fam"/> In the same year, the scientist became the head of Laboratory No.13 of Physical Problems of Control of Gas-Dynamic Flows at the [[Khristianovich Institute of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics]].<ref name="lab13">{{Cite web |title=Лаб.13. Физических проблем управления газодинамическими течениями |url=http://www.itam.nsc.ru/structure/labs/lab13_fizicheskih_problem_upravleniya_gazodinamich/index.html |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=www.itam.nsc.ru}}</ref> Thanks to the skills of experimental work and numerical simulation in supersonic aerodynamics, as well as experience in large aerodynamic installations, he significantly intensified the scientific activity of the laboratory.<ref name="lab13" />

===Suspicion of state treason and arrest===
On 28 June 2022, Anatoly Maslov was arrested on suspicion of state [[treason]]. He was taken by plane to Moscow and placed in the [[Lefortovo Prison|Lefortovo]] pre-trial detention center. A few days later, another [[Novosibirsk]] scientist, [[Dmitry Kolker]] was also arrested on suspicion of state treason.<ref>{{Cite web |title=За госизмену арестован еще один ученый Академгородка Анатолий Маслов |url=https://poisknews.ru/news/za-gosizmenu-arestovan-eshhe-odin-uchenyj-akademgorodka-anatolij-maslov/ |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=poisknews.ru |language=ru-RU}}</ref> The trial has been registered with the St. Petersburg City Court on May 12, 2023, in a "top secret" case according to the court’s press office.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 May 2023 |title=Who are the three Russian scientists accused of state treason? |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/who-are-three-russian-scientists-accused-state-treason-2023-05-18/ |access-date=22 May 2024 |website=Reuters}}</ref> On 21 May 2024, he was sentenced to 14 years in prison.<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 May 2024 |title=Russia sentences another hypersonics expert to 14 years for treason |website=[[Reuters]] |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-hypersonics-expert-jailed-14-years-treason-2024-05-21/ }}</ref>
